name: kb_arcane_mage
notes: The Turtle knowledge base's arcane raid list: Arcane Rupture whenever its debuff is down and inside Arcane Power, Arcane Missiles as the filler and on a Clearcasting proc, Arcane Surge only outside Arcane Power and outside the Rupture debuff, Fire Blast while moving, Arcane Explosion on 3+ mobs. The KB's opener order, the trinket/haste stacking, the Surge haste cutoff and the resist that makes Arcane Surge usable are not conditions (kb.unexpressed).

priorities.note: mob_distance_max 10 is Arcane Explosion's own radius: a self-targeted area spell has no range check otherwise.
Moved after the AoE entry: a channel with no cooldown as a rule would starve every entry the KB lists after it (the filler is last).
power_above 99 is the KB's "at full mana only"; the 10% mana death is the spell's own rule.
the KB gives no mana number: 20% is this recipe's; the server mana tick is not a condition.
a racial: level-independent in the data, so marked talent (no level check); cast only when the spellbook has it.

unexpressed.text: Opener: on-use SP trinket -> Arcane Rupture -> Arcane Missiles -> (Surge proc: Arcane Surge + Presence of Mind in its GCD) -> Missiles -> Rupture -> Mind Quickening Gem + Arcane Power during the GCD -> Missiles | pull, full mana
unexpressed.why: pre-pull/opener outside the brain's fight; consumable or item (combat_consumables owns items)

unexpressed.text: Arcane Rupture | Arcane Power (or big haste window) active AND Rupture debuff not on target
unexpressed.why: a haste window that is not Arcane Power is not a condition

unexpressed.text: Arcane Missiles | Arcane Power active; never Surge or PoM inside AP/MQG
unexpressed.why: the Mind Quickening Gem is consumable or item (combat_consumables owns items)

unexpressed.text: Arcane Rupture | Rupture debuff not active (cancel Missiles right after a tick)

Arcane Surge | usable (a spell of yours was resisted) AND total haste below the Surge cutoff; cast in the last second of the Rupture debuff or with no debuff; >50% mana cancel Missiles at once, <50% wait until the last moment
unexpressed.why: the resist that makes Arcane Surge usable and the total-haste cutoff are not conditions; cancel/stop casting not expressible

unexpressed.text: Arcane Missiles | default filler; never re-press mid-channel without Nampower
Pre-stack Sigil of Ancient Accord with rank-1 Arcane Explosion before the pull
unexpressed.why: pre-pull/opener outside the brain's fight; consumable or item (combat_consumables owns items)

unexpressed.text: Downrank Arcane Explosion / Eye of Diminution / Fetish of the Sand Reaver / LIP
unexpressed.why: consumable or item (combat_consumables owns items); the tank's threat is not a condition

unexpressed.text: Goblin Sapper Charge + Arcane Jewel of Wild Magics + Arcane Explosion

unexpressed.why: a gap in the KB (no source states 2-target handling): there is nothing to express

unexpressed.text: Mind Quickening Gem | first; Arcane Power near the end of MQG (snapshots haste, shortens AP cooldown); low gear haste (~7%): both together is fine; stack everything only on <30 s fights
Juju Flurry / Potion of Quickness | during Arcane Power unless at a hard cap; Juju up to ~12% gear haste, Quickness ~10%, both ~7%
Presence of Mind | instant Arcane Rupture; cast standalone (macro bug); not in AP
Evocation | start just before a server mana tick, cancel after the 4th tick
unexpressed.why: cancel/stop casting not expressible; the server mana tick is not a condition

unexpressed.text: Berserking (Troll) | haste cooldown, same spread/stack rules
unexpressed.why: haste stacking is not a condition
